runs: every hour, after each run of the presidential forecast
what: The Senate forecast: reads Wikipedia, reruns the forecast and writes data/senate/<year>/ and docs/api/senate.json, which the Senate tab reads. A run whose readings look wrong stops and leaves the last forecast in place.
how_to_read: ok false: the last run failed, error says why, and the site keeps the last good figures. ok true but today later than overdue_after: the job has stopped running. The workflow link lists every run.
